meta_description: Architecture, security posture and compliance evidence for Dataq Forge — Data & Lakehouse Engineering Platform from Dataq Software.

blocks.x: Dataq Forge's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally Dataq Forge is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate, Dataq Forge architecture edition:

items: feature store, vector search, retrieval services
owned, SLA'd products with consumer contracts

blocks.x: In Dataq Forge, instrumented from week one, on your channels:

items: sharing without exposure for data products

blocks.x: Runtime dependencies: Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, dbt, Unity Catalog/Purview. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Dataq Forge follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: Dataq Forge architecture baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
